title: Editorial: ACM/Springer Mobile Networks & Applications - Special Issue on Mobile Service Computing and Applications
motivation: 移动设备和无线技术快速发展,传统服务计算在移动环境中面临机遇
problem_framing: 移动服务计算的挑战包括持续移动性、能力受限、电力有限、安全无保证等
key_insight: 服务不再是传统平台限定,可部署在移动设备或云服务器通过无线网络交付
method_signature: 综述特刊六篇高质量论文,无原创方法提出
evaluation_criteria: 选择具有高质量的六篇论文
evidence_for_taste: 特刊 features six selected papers with high quality
bridging the gap between business and IT services
great challenges for both service provision and consumption
thinking_moves: 定义服务计算的范式价值——桥接业务与IT服务
